comment: Owner only. Copy to OSGSim/realm-authority.json and run Start-SpeXGSP.bat -CreateUniverse. realmName: the ROD name joiners look up (default spexgsp/universe/default; joiners pass -Universe <realmName> otherwise). gameId: 1-40 letters/digits, registered as g/<gameId>. ownerAddress: a legacy address in a loaded wallet, or null for a new address in the SpeXGSP wallet. relayHost: public IP address of the PC that runs the relay, optionally with :port (IP only, no host names; default port 7447); -CreateUniverse generates that relay's TLS certificate and publishes its key hash, joiners trust the relay through ROD. relays: optional extra wss:// relays (up to 6 in total, certificates from a CA). The wallet pays two name registrations.
